title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: What water breaks are for
hook: What do you say during a water break?
intro: You have a point you want to make.
statement: A break can teach or it can rest. Not always both.
q1: Do you use water breaks for quick coaching —
q2: or let kids rest and talk with each other?
q3: What do kids talk about when you stay quiet?
t1: Both can work. But the next drill goes better
t2: when kids come back rested and ready.
cta: Coaches — what happens at your water breaks?
ctaLines: One quick point. Free time. Check on a player.
ctaPrompt: Share your break habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do you say during a water break?
Kids run to their bottles. You have a point you want to make.
A break can teach or it can rest. Not always both.
Teach during breaks or let kids rest. There is no perfect answer.
What happens at your water breaks? Share your habit in the comments.
